method.class: Low-dimensional graph-statistic regression predictor of cover time: log cover time as a (log-)linear/ridge model over cheap statistics (n, m, mean degree, max degree, diameter, simple derived ratios), fit in-episode on labeled training graphs and compared with the generic 2m(n-1) bound and constant controls.
method.description: On connected graphs with 6<=n<=30 from the declared synthetic families, a small set of cheap graph statistics predicts MC cover time with lower family-macro log error than the generic 2m(n-1) bound on held-out (content-hash-disjoint) final graphs, with per-family error reported with Monte Carlo and bootstrap uncertainty; claim limited to the sampled families/sizes, start-averaged cover time, and small per-family test counts (a connectivity smoke-test scale), without asserting reliability beyond them.

protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility (correct) requires: every declared episode completes with exactly one reset in the declared order, finite positive predictions for all test graphs, verified non-vacuous permuted-input and shuffled-target controls, perm_max_rel_dev <= 1e-6, valid simulator check, finite metrics; no comparative threshold gates search. Eligible candidates are ranked by combined_score = -macro_log_mae (higher is better); ties broken by lower worst-family log error then code hash. Final claim (final correct) additionally requires macro_log_mae strictly below bound_macro_log_mae on the sealed final plane; ties or incomplete evidence do not support the claim.

required_evidence: Deterministic search policy: candidate eligible iff search integrity `correct` holds; rank by combined_score (higher better); ties broken by lower worst-family log error, then lexicographic code hash; with the 1-cycle x 1-evaluation campaign the single evaluated candidate is frozen if eligible, otherwise final claims are reported as incomplete evidence (no final reinterpretation); candidate frozen before final seeds/manifests are revealed.

Separation of scientific validity (MC simulator validated vs closed-form/exact cover times; MC SE reported), search eligibility (integrity gates, no publication veto) and final claim assessment (strict improvement over the 2m(n-1) bound under macro log error, ties and incomplete/failed evidence => claim not supported).

Hash-based disjointness report: canonical content hashes of all search vs final graphs (and train vs test within plane) with empty intersections, fixed normalization before splitting, plus source IDs, family parameters, generator seeds and split manifests.

Evidence that reset transcripts match production (search [101,102], final [201,202,203]) and smoke (one first-seed episode each) exactly, one reset per episode in order, no extra resets or replay; plane seeds disjoint.

Control results on matched inputs: constant, 2m(n-1) bound/copy, shuffled-pairing derangement (non-identity verified) and permuted-input invariance (non-identity relabeling verified); a vacuous control is rejected rather than reported as a causal conclusion.

Per-family and overall errors with Monte Carlo uncertainty (per-graph MC SE, noise floor mc_rel_se_median), paired bootstrap CI of improvement vs bound over test graphs, and across-seed spread; explicit statement of small per-family test counts and where the predictor is reliable or fails.

Payload preflight: serialized largest production request and response measured in UTF-8 JSON bytes including envelope/framing, each strictly below 64 MiB; RPC call counts per plane against max_candidate_rpc_calls including all chunk calls.

Distinction between hard-enforced limits (evaluator wall-clock, broker RPC calls) and advisory candidate-internal iteration counts; trusted evaluator-owned MC walk counts; smoke runs only attest the reduced path, not the production workload; wall-clock calibration from scaffold smoke.

Reproduction instructions (environment, offline dependency plan, commands, seeds), the short paper (<=4 pages, ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS official template) and a statement of compliance with the forbidden-source rule (no access to the original answering paper or mirrors); no claim without logs actually produced.
